This suggests that Kazinol J could act as a modulator of MAP3K8, potentially influencing downstream signaling pathways. The mechanism is supported by the known role of Tubulin--tyrosine ligase in cellular processes, and the involvement of Acrivastine in MAP3K8 inhibition.
